title: Eagle Sports Range
specs: Over 100 firearms available to rent and shoot
Valid FOID card required for rentals
Must be 21 or older to rent firearms
Children 10+ allowed with adult supervision after Junior Shooters Safety Course
No more than two guests may share a lane; one shooter per lane at a time
includes: Use of firearms for rental pass
gap: Duration of sessions not explicitly stated
blurb: Eagle Sports Range offers a state-of-the-art indoor shooting range with 30 lanes at 25 yards and 6 lanes at 50 yards. Guests can rent from over 100 firearms and switch guns during their session. The facility emphasizes safety, education, and training in a family-oriented atmosphere.
extraNote: No tracer, armor piercing, steel casing ammo, or shot shells allowed · No rapid fire, double tap, or drawing from holster permitted with rentals · Last range check-in accepted half an hour before close · No intoxicating substances allowed; intoxicated individuals prohibited
